_note: Endpoint manifest — generated from captured recordings + wallet JS analysis. One entry per API endpoint the cloned frontend calls. The route-implementer agent creates one src/routes/<name>.route.ts per entry; smoke.mjs tests each.

endpoints.name: rpc_devnet
endpoints.notes: Devnet JSON-RPC multiplexer. Dispatches by method field to the handlers below.

endpoints.name: rpc_mainnet
endpoints.notes: Mainnet JSON-RPC multiplexer. Same dispatch logic as devnet.

endpoints.name: indexer_health
endpoints.notes: Indexer health check. Called from /tokens/ page.

endpoints.name: healthz
endpoints.notes: Server health check. Referenced in 4702 constants as rpc-worldstreet.intertrain.online/healthz.

endpoints.name: metrics
endpoints.notes: Prometheus metrics endpoint. Referenced in 4702 constants.

rpc_methods.notes: Chain metadata: chain_id, heights, native asset info. Polled every 10s by the landing page and wallet.
Current validator set. Polled alongside chain_info on the landing page.
Account balance, nonce, and per-asset balances. Called before every transaction/token op to get nonce.
All bridged/wrapped assets with their enabled status. Drives the wallet's asset list.
Per-lane bridge status (Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, USDC). Already in rpc.json seed.
MNA reserve collateralization, rates, totals. Already in rpc.json seed.
Broadcast a signed native transfer. Returns {hash}.
Poll transaction confirmation status. Returns status: confirmed|pending|not_found.
List all native tokens with metadata, supply, holder counts.
Derive the EVM address for a native token by its token_id hash. For MetaMask import.
Prepare a token operation (Create/Transfer/Mint/Burn/Freeze). Returns signing_bytes.
Broadcast a signed token operation. Returns {operation_id, token_id}.
Poll token operation confirmation. Returns status + operation details.
Generate a one-time challenge for wallet ownership proof. Returns {message, nonce}.
Verify a signed auth challenge. Returns {session_token}.
Get a USDC-to-WSK (or reverse) conversion quote with rate and amounts.
Prepare an MNA reserve swap (MintMna or RedeemMna). Returns signing_bytes.
Broadcast a signed MNA swap. Returns {operation_id}.
Poll MNA swap confirmation status.
Oracle quote for SOL-to-WSK conversion via the Solana bridge lane.
Devnet-only faucet that credits test WSK to the given address.
